ValidationRule.description: For Sales Offers, if Justification = Other, Justification/Escalation Reasons can't be blank
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND ( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Sales_Offers_Request", ISPICKVAL( Justification_p__c , "Other"), ISBLANK ( Justification__c )
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Justification/Escalation Reasons cannot be blank if Justification is 'Other'
